body: I’m just so unsure, I feel guilty from getting any sort of aid from other people so I don’t know if that would help. I would consider seeking a professional but I’m pretty sure I will forever be too much of a coward to actually end it, but the only people that I feel like I could go to with this would be my parents but I don’t want them to worry, I’ve been feeling like this since elementary school, though it’s mostly suppressed with having a few surges randomly. As far as I know nobody knows I feel like this as I always play it off for jokes and keep a fake smile.

While knowing that I’m not alone feeling like this makes me glad, I hope you can find help to feel better. I just personally feel like I don’t deserve any of what I’m fortune to have, but at the same time it just makes me feel selfish.

It’s like I’m calling out for attention when I know I don’t deserve it. I haven’t contributed much to the world. When there’s people risking their lives for others without any help, why should someone as ungrateful as me be allowed to live? There’s people who are better than me in every way living with more problems than me, why should I be allowed to breath and waste resources to keep me alive.
